title: C17 tail-index variant
description: Catalog row c17-outputs 1.0.0: one tail index of the operational risk case (outputs.kind tail-index), LDA against SMA on a generator of operational loss histories with a known true annual loss distribution.

p05.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

p25.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

median.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

p75.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

p95.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

c17MoneyQuantiles.description: Percentiles across the replications of a money quantity, in EUR, nondecreasing.

c17RatioQuantiles.description: Percentiles across the replications of a ratio to the true 99.9 percent annual loss quantile.

c17IlmQuantiles.description: Percentiles across the replications of the internal loss multiplier (OPE25.8).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block: C17 is in EUR throughout (the LDCE calibration is in EUR).

counted_above_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

frequency.description: The generator's true annual frequency: Poisson, losses per year at or above `counted_above_eur` (the generator floor, equal to the severity location).

location_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

tail_index.description: A tail index of the SDD section 5 grid: 0.6, 0.8, 0.96 or 1.1.

severity.description: The generator's true severity: a generalised Pareto distribution with the tail index of the variant, starting at `location_eur` (the generator floor, no loss is generated below it). Threshold-stable: the loss above any higher collection threshold is again a GPD with the same tail index.

level.description: The quantile level of C17: the 99.9 percent annual loss quantile, as a decimal.

agrees.description: A truth that fails its Monte Carlo check (the value within 3 standard errors) is not published.

annual_loss_quantile.description: The true 99.9 percent quantile of the annual loss of the generating process (all generated losses at or above the generator floor, whatever the collection threshold): computed once by Panjer or FFT on a fine grid and checked by Monte Carlo.

value_eur.description: Null exactly when the tail index is 1 or more: the mean is infinite.

reason.description: Why the mean is absent; null when it is given.

c17Truth.description: The generator's true parameters and the true 99.9 percent annual loss quantile, labelled synthetic-known-truth. Required in every C17 document: nothing is scored without them.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block: C17 is in EUR throughout (the LDCE calibration is in EUR).

source.description: BCBS, Results from the 2008 Loss Data Collection Exercise for Operational Risk (BCBS 160).

threshold_eur.description: The LDCE statistics are of losses of EUR 20,000 or more.

frequency.description: The median bank's frequency of losses of EUR 20,000 or more per year per EUR billion of consolidated assets.

severity_percentiles.description: Median across banks of each bank's percentile of the severity (losses of EUR 20,000 or more, Table ILD7), transcribed and locked: the four pairs, each once; the documents carry only the statistics the calibration uses, never a reproduction of the BCBS tables.

c17Ldce.description: The BCBS 2008 LDCE calibration targets with their source and the derived-only label (SDD section 5).

tail_index.description: A tail index of the SDD section 5 grid: 0.6, 0.8, 0.96 or 1.1.

fitted_quantiles_eur.description: The generator's severity quantiles at the four LDCE percentiles, increasing.

max_abs_log_error.description: Largest |ln(fitted / target)| over the four percentiles.

c17CalibrationFit.description: The generator's scale fitted to the four LDCE percentiles at the variant's tail index (least squares on the log quantiles).

ildc_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

sc_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

fc_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

bi_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

c17Bi.description: The business indicator BI = ILDC + SC + FC (OPE25.4) of the synthetic bank, three-year averages.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block: C17 is in EUR throughout (the LDCE calibration is in EUR).

bic_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

c17Bank.description: The synthetic bank of stated size whose losses the generator draws and whose business indicator feeds the SMA; never a real bank.

n_defined.description: Replications with a defined value (a failed fit, or a fit with an infinite mean for a mean-based form, is not counted).

log_sd.description: Standard deviation across the replications of ln(capital / true quantile).

c17Capital.description: The 99.9 percent capital of one rung across the independent histories of a cell: percentiles, the ratio to the true quantile (bias), the share of histories that underestimate it and the dispersion.

n_defined.description: Replications with a defined value (a failed fit, or a fit with an infinite mean for a mean-based form, is not counted).

log_sd.description: Standard deviation across the replications of ln(capital / true quantile).

c17CapitalUnverified.description: The 99.9 percent capital of one rung across the independent histories of a cell: percentiles, the ratio to the true quantile (bias), the share of histories that underestimate it and the dispersion.

c17MeanCorrectedSla.description: The mean-corrected single loss approximation F^-1(1 - (1 - alpha) / lambda) + lambda E[X], labelled UNVERIFIED until it is checked against Bocker and Sprittulla (2006) or Degen (2010). Null with its reason when the tail index is 1 or more (no mean).

c17OptionalCapital.description: A rung the bake may not have evaluated for a cell: the summary, or null with its reason.

c17CapitalByRung.description: The ladder of dossier 05: rung 1 the Poisson-lognormal LDA fitted ignoring the collection threshold (the biased baseline), rung 2 the truncated severity with the frequency rescaled, rung 3 the lognormal body and GPD tail splice, rung 4 the aggregation by Panjer or FFT (the `aggregation` of each), rung 5 the single loss approximation with (UNVERIFIED) and without the mean correction, rung 6 the scenario combination.

seed_first.description: Replication i uses the seed seed_first + i; the ranges are disjoint between cells and variants.

n_failed.description: Histories whose fit failed to converge; they are counted, never dropped silently.

n_losses_median.description: Median number of recorded losses per history.

c17Replications.description: Independent simulated loss histories: the seeds, the count and the failures. The histories are not in the document.

c17Agreement.description: Largest relative difference of the 99.9 percent capital between the Panjer and the FFT aggregation of the same fit.

threshold_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

c17StabilityRow.description: The fitted GPD tail index above one threshold across the replications; share_at_least_one is the share of fits with an infinite-mean tail index.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block: C17 is in EUR throughout (the LDCE calibration is in EUR).

bic_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

c17SmaCell.description: The SMA capital of the synthetic bank on the same histories as the LDA of the cell, with the discretion applied as a named field (OPE25.11). ORC = BIC x ILM (OPE25.2), LC = 15 x the average annual loss over the history (OPE25.8). A C17 history is 5 or 10 years, so an ILM is always computable (OPE25.15: under 5 years capital is BIC only, a case of the engine `sma_capital` that no C17 cell reaches). The SMA is not calibrated to the 99.9 percent quantile of any bank: the ratio to the true quantile is a comparison, not a claim of equivalence.

years.description: Years of recorded losses in each history: 5 or 10 (the grid of SDD section 5).

collection_threshold_eur.description: The collection threshold: losses below it are not recorded.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block: C17 is in EUR throughout (the LDCE calibration is in EUR).

c17Cell.description: One cell of the grid (years x collection threshold) of a tail-index variant, as replication summaries.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block: C17 is in EUR throughout (the LDCE calibration is in EUR).

items.description: A share in [0, 1], or null past the last node of the Panjer recursion grid (the recursion computes no probability there; the nulls are a suffix of the axis).

c17Exceedance.description: P(annual loss > x) of the true distribution on one grid by Monte Carlo, Panjer and FFT, with the 99.9 percent quantile of each and of the single loss approximation (the marker).

added_loss_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

lc_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

orc_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

lda_capital_eur.description: The 99.9 percent LDA capital of the same history with the same loss added.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block: C17 is in EUR throughout (the LDCE calibration is in EUR).

bic_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

c17SmaResponse.description: The ILM and the capital of one history as a single large loss of growing size is added to its latest year.

capital_without_eur.description: Money in EUR (the `currency` of the enclosing block).

influence.description: (base capital - capital without the point) / base capital.

prior_kind.description: The prior of the Bayesian credibility, stated on every result (decision D4): Gamma on the Pareto shape alpha = 1 / xi, unrestricted.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block: C17 is in EUR throughout (the LDCE calibration is in EUR).

level.description: The quantile level of C17: the 99.9 percent annual loss quantile, as a decimal.

c17ScenarioInfluence.description: The 99.9 percent capital's sensitivity to each scenario point of one history (the scenario influence).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block: C17 is in EUR throughout (the LDCE calibration is in EUR).

tail_index.description: A tail index of the SDD section 5 grid: 0.6, 0.8, 0.96 or 1.1.

infinite_mean.description: True exactly when the tail index is 1 or more: the mean is infinite, no mean-based quantity is computed and the mean-corrected SLA is absent.

cells.description: The grid in fixed order: 5 years then 10 years, each at collection threshold 10,000 then 20,000.

c17Outputs.description: C17 tail-index outputs (outputs.kind tail-index): one tail index of the generator of operational loss histories for a synthetic bank, calibrated to the BCBS 2008 LDCE quantiles, whose true annual loss distribution is known; the four cells of 5 or 10 years and a collection threshold of 10,000 or 20,000 as replication summaries; money in EUR.
